data.long_meaning: The name Frederich is derived from the Old High German words "fred" meaning peace and "ric" meaning ruler or power. The name Frederich was popular among Germanic and European royalty throughout history. It was also a common name for saints and martyrs in the Christian faith. The name Frederich carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Frederich usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Frederich carries a deep spiritual significance as it is associated with the idea of a peaceful ruler or a powerful servant of God.
